56				),
57				encoding="utf-8",
58			)
59			try:
60				self.model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path(str(path))
61			finally:
62				path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
63			self.layout = layout
64			self.physics = physics
65			self.assisted_grasp = assisted_grasp
66			self.sensor_noise = sensor_noise
67			self.data = mujoco.MjData(self.model)
68			self.renderer = mujoco.Renderer(self.model, RENDER_SIZE[1], RENDER_SIZE[0]) if render_enabled else None
69			self.held: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None = None
70			self.settle_frames = 0
71			m = self.model
72	
73			def body(name: str) -> int:
74				return mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, name)
75	
76			self.site = mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE, "gripperframe")
77			self.brick_body = body("brick")
78			self.grip_body = body("gripper")
79			self.jaw_body = body("moving_jaw_so101_v1")
80			# arm joints in JOINTS order: qpos addresses, dof (Jacobian column) addresses and position limits
81			self.qadr = [int(m.joint(j).qposadr[0]) for j in JOINTS]
82			self.dofadr = [int(m.joint(j).dofadr[0]) for j in JOINTS]
83			self.jnt_range = m.jnt_range[[m.joint(j).id for j in JOINTS]].copy()
84			self.brick_qadr = int(m.joint("brick").qposadr[0])
85			self.brick_dofadr = int(m.joint("brick").dofadr[0])
86			self._cam_ids = {m.camera(c).name: c for c in range(m.ncam)}
87	
88			robot_root = m.body_rootid[self.grip_body]
89			self.robot_geoms = np.array(
90				[g for g in range(m.ngeom) if m.body_rootid[m.geom_bodyid[g]] == robot_root and m.geom_group[g] == 3]
91			)
92			# links that move with the shoulder lift (the base and shoulder sit on the table by design)
93			lift_body = m.jnt_bodyid[m.joint("shoulder_lift").id]
94	
95			def moves(b: int) -> bool:
96				while b > 0:
97					if b == lift_body:
98						return True
99					b = m.body_parentid[b]
100				return False
101	
102			self.link_geoms = np.array([g for g in self.robot_geoms if moves(m.geom_bodyid[g])])
103			self.defect_geoms = np.array(
104				[mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM, f"defect_{k}") for k in range(2)], dtype=int
105			)
106			self.brick_geoms = np.array([g for g in range(m.ngeom) if m.geom_bodyid[g] == self.brick_body])
107			self.fixed_jaw_geoms = {
108				g for g in range(m.ngeom) if m.geom_bodyid[g] == self.grip_body and m.geom_group[g] in (3, 4)
109			}
110			self.moving_jaw_geoms = {
111				g for g in range(m.ngeom) if m.geom_bodyid[g] == self.jaw_body and m.geom_group[g] in (3, 4)
112			}
113			self.non_jaw_robot_geoms = {
114				int(g)
115				for g in self.link_geoms
116				if int(g) not in self.fixed_jaw_geoms and int(g) not in self.moving_jaw_geoms
117			}
118			self.robot_all_geoms = {g for g in range(m.ngeom) if m.body_rootid[m.geom_bodyid[g]] == robot_root}
119	
120			if physics is not None:
121				self._apply_physics_spec(physics, mass_scale=mass_scale, friction_scale=friction_scale)
122	
123			# Segmentation lookups indexed by geom id; the extra last entry stays False and takes index -1 (not a geom).
124			self._is_defect = np.zeros(m.ngeom + 1, bool)
125			self._is_defect[self.defect_geoms] = True
126			self._is_brick = np.zeros(m.ngeom + 1, bool)
127			self._is_brick[self.brick_geoms] = True
128			# A plain int: comparing an array with the pybind11 enum itself runs a Python call per pixel (about 65 ms
129			# for one cropped image against 0.04 ms).
130			self._obj_geom = int(mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM)
131			self._all_groups = mujoco.MjvOption()
132			self._all_groups.geomgroup[:] = 1
133			self._all_groups.geomgroup[3:5] = 0
134			self._brick_only = mujoco.MjvOption()
135			self._brick_only.geomgroup[:] = 0
136			self._brick_only.geomgroup[0] = 1
137			self._brick_only.geomgroup[PROBE_GROUP] = 1
138			self._ray_z: tuple[tuple, np.ndarray] | None = None
139			self._cam_poses: dict[str, CameraPose] = {}
140			if layout.top is not None:
141				self._cam_poses["top"] = layout.top
142			if layout.front is not None:
143				self._cam_poses["front"] = layout.front

145		def _apply_physics_spec(self, physics: PhysicsSpec, mass_scale: float, friction_scale: float) -> None:
146			"""Align MuJoCo actuator gains, joint dynamics, and surface friction with :class:`PhysicsSpec`."""
147			m = self.model
148			for idx, jname in enumerate(JOINTS):
149				act_id = mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR, jname)
150				spec = physics.gripper_actuator if jname == "gripper" else physics.arm_actuator
151				m.actuator_gainprm[act_id, 0] = spec.stiffness
152				m.actuator_biasprm[act_id, 1] = -spec.stiffness
153				m.actuator_biasprm[act_id, 2] = -spec.damping
154				m.actuator_forcerange[act_id] = (-spec.effort_limit, spec.effort_limit)
155				dof = self.dofadr[idx]
156				m.dof_damping[dof] = spec.joint_damping
157				m.dof_frictionloss[dof] = spec.frictionloss
158				m.dof_armature[dof] = spec.armature
159	
160			# Surface frictions (MuJoCo combines contacts via max by default when priorities match)
161			for g in self.fixed_jaw_geoms | self.moving_jaw_geoms:
162				m.geom_priority[g] = 0
163				m.geom_friction[g] = (physics.gripper_pad.static_friction * friction_scale, 0.005, 0.0005)
164			table_gid = mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM, "table")
165			if table_gid >= 0:
166				m.geom_friction[table_gid] = (physics.table.dynamic_friction * friction_scale, 0.005, 0.0005)
167			for bname in ("green_bowl", "pink_bowl"):
168				bid = mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, bname)
169				if bid >= 0:
170					for g in range(m.ngeom):
171						if m.geom_bodyid[g] == bid and m.geom_contype[g] != 0:
172							m.geom_friction[g] = (physics.plate.dynamic_friction * friction_scale, 0.005, 0.0005)
173			bspec = brick_spec_for_size(self.layout.brick_size, physics).scaled(mass_scale, friction_scale)
174			# Note: body_mass/inertia already set in MJCF _brick when physics is passed, ensure inertia matches scaled box
175			sx, sy, sz = self.layout.brick_size
176			m.body_mass[self.brick_body] = bspec.mass_kg
177			m.body_inertia[self.brick_body] = (
178				bspec.mass_kg * (sy**2 + sz**2) / 12.0,
179				bspec.mass_kg * (sx**2 + sz**2) / 12.0,
180				bspec.mass_kg * (sx**2 + sy**2) / 12.0,
181			)

202		def set_camera(self, name: str, pose: CameraPose) -> None:
203			"""Move an existing camera in place (no recompilation)."""
204			cid = self.camera_id(name)
205			right, up = pose.axes()
206			mat = np.column_stack([right, up, np.cross(right, up)])
207			quat = np.zeros(4)
208			mujoco.mju_mat2Quat(quat, mat.flatten())
209			self.model.cam_pos[cid] = (pose.x, pose.y, pose.height)
210			self.model.cam_quat[cid] = quat
211			width = self.model.cam_resolution[cid][0]
212			self.model.cam_intrinsic[cid][:2] = pose.focal_px * self.model.cam_sensorsize[cid][0] / width
213			self._cam_poses[name] = pose
214			mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)

216		def joints(self) -> np.ndarray:

219		def step(self, ctrl: np.ndarray) -> None:
220			self.data.ctrl[:6] = ctrl
221			if self.settle_frames <= 0:
222				mujoco.mj_step(self.model, self.data, nstep=SUBSTEPS)
223				return
224			# Just after release the brick may still overlap a jaw or the clutter it was held against; cap its speed for
225			# a few frames so penetration is resolved as a drop instead of an ejection.
226			vadr = self.brick_dofadr
227			for _ in range(SUBSTEPS):
228				mujoco.mj_step(self.model, self.data)
229				v = self.data.qvel[vadr : vadr + 6]
230				v[:3] *= min(1.0, RELEASE_MAX_SPEED / max(float(np.linalg.norm(v[:3])), 1e-9))
231				v[3:] *= min(1.0, 10.0 / max(float(np.linalg.norm(v[3:])), 1e-9))
232			self.settle_frames -= 1

234		def update_grasp(self, gripper_cmd: float) -> None:
235			"""Assisted grasp when ``self.assisted_grasp`` is True; pure contact friction otherwise."""
236			if not self.assisted_grasp:
237				return
238			d = self.data
239			if self.held is None:
240				closed = gripper_cmd < 0.0 and d.qpos[self.qadr[5]] < 0.35
241				near = np.linalg.norm(self.brick_pos() - d.site_xpos[self.site]) < GRASP_RADIUS_M
242				if closed and near:
243					rot_g = d.xmat[self.grip_body].reshape(3, 3)
244					rot_b = d.xmat[self.brick_body].reshape(3, 3)
245					self.held = (rot_g.T @ (self.brick_pos() - d.xpos[self.grip_body]), rot_g.T @ rot_b)
246				return
247			if gripper_cmd > 0.3:
248				self.held = None
249				self.settle_frames = RELEASE_SETTLE_FRAMES
250				return
251			d.qvel[self.brick_dofadr : self.brick_dofadr + 6] = 0.0
252			self.place_held()

280		def jaw_force_components(self) -> tuple[float, float, float, float, float, float]:
281			"""Return ``(fix_norm, fix_tan, fix_total, mov_norm, mov_tan, mov_total)`` contact forces in N."""
282			f_fix_w = np.zeros(3)
283			f_mov_w = np.zeros(3)
284			fix_n = 0.0
285			mov_n = 0.0
286			fix_t_vec = np.zeros(2)
287			mov_t_vec = np.zeros(2)
288			cforce = np.zeros(6)
289			brick_set = {int(g) for g in self.brick_geoms}
290			for cid in range(self.data.ncon):
291				con = self.data.contact[cid]
292				g1, g2 = int(con.geom1), int(con.geom2)
293				other = g2 if g1 in brick_set else (g1 if g2 in brick_set else -1)
294				if other < 0:
295					continue
296				if other in self.fixed_jaw_geoms or other in self.moving_jaw_geoms:
297					mujoco.mj_contactForce(self.model, self.data, cid, cforce)
298					world_f = con.frame.reshape(3, 3).T @ cforce[:3]
299					if other in self.fixed_jaw_geoms:
300						f_fix_w += world_f
301						fix_n += abs(float(cforce[0]))
302						fix_t_vec += cforce[1:3]
303					else:
304						f_mov_w += world_f
305						mov_n += abs(float(cforce[0]))
306						mov_t_vec += cforce[1:3]
307			return (
308				fix_n,
309				float(np.linalg.norm(fix_t_vec)),
310				float(np.linalg.norm(f_fix_w)),
311				mov_n,
312				float(np.linalg.norm(mov_t_vec)),
313				float(np.linalg.norm(f_mov_w)),
314			)
315	
316		def jaw_forces(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
317			"""Total contact force magnitude (N) between each jaw and the target brick."""
318			_, _, f_fix, _, _, f_mov = self.jaw_force_components()
319			return f_fix, f_mov

321		def actuator_torques(self) -> np.ndarray:
322			"""Solver-applied generalized actuator forces/torques (N or N*m) ordered by :data:`JOINTS`."""
323			return np.array([float(self.data.actuator_force[self.model.actuator(j).id]) for j in JOINTS], dtype=np.float64)
324	
325		def step_with_telemetry(self, ctrl: np.ndarray, substeps: int = SUBSTEPS) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
326			"""Advance ``substeps`` MuJoCo steps while sampling substep contact forces and actuator torques."""
327			self.data.ctrl[:6] = ctrl
328			jaw_total = np.zeros((substeps, 2), dtype=np.float64)
329			jaw_normal = np.zeros((substeps, 2), dtype=np.float64)
330			jaw_tan = np.zeros((substeps, 2), dtype=np.float64)
331			unint = np.zeros(substeps, dtype=np.float64)
332			torques = np.zeros((substeps, 6), dtype=np.float64)
333			for s in range(substeps):
334				mujoco.mj_step(self.model, self.data)
335				fn0, ft0, tot0, fn1, ft1, tot1 = self.jaw_force_components()
336				jaw_normal[s] = (fn0, fn1)
337				jaw_tan[s] = (ft0, ft1)
338				jaw_total[s] = (tot0, tot1)
339				unint[s] = self.unintended_force()
340				torques[s] = self.actuator_torques()
341			return {
342				"jaw_total": jaw_total,
343				"jaw_normal": jaw_normal,
344				"jaw_tangential": jaw_tan,
345				"unintended": unint,
346				"torques": torques,
347			}
348	
349		def unintended_force(self) -> float:
350			"""Peak external contact force magnitude (N) on non-jaw robot links (ignores internal self-collisions)."""
351			peak = 0.0
352			cforce = np.zeros(6)
353			for cid in range(self.data.ncon):
354				con = self.data.contact[cid]
355				g1, g2 = int(con.geom1), int(con.geom2)
356				if (g1 in self.non_jaw_robot_geoms and g2 not in self.robot_all_geoms) or (
357					g2 in self.non_jaw_robot_geoms and g1 not in self.robot_all_geoms
358				):
359					mujoco.mj_contactForce(self.model, self.data, cid, cforce)
360					peak = max(peak, float(np.linalg.norm(cforce[:3])))
361			return peak

363		def place_held(self) -> None:
364			"""Put the held brick where the stored grasp puts it relative to the gripper (after joints changed)."""
365			if self.held is None:
366				return
367			m, d = self.model, self.data
368			mujoco.mj_kinematics(m, d)
369			rel_p, rel_r = self.held
370			rot_g = d.xmat[self.grip_body].reshape(3, 3)
371			adr = self.brick_qadr
372			d.qpos[adr : adr + 3] = d.xpos[self.grip_body] + rot_g @ rel_p
373			quat = np.zeros(4)
374			mujoco.mju_mat2Quat(quat, (rot_g @ rel_r).flatten())
375			d.qpos[adr + 3 : adr + 7] = quat
376			mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)

378		def visibility(
379			self, camera: str, crop: tuple[int, int, int, int] | None = None, full: bool = True
380		) -> dict[str, int]:
381			"""Pixel counts in ``camera``: defect and brick pixels visible in the scene, and the same with the arm
382			removed (``*_full``, skipped unless ``full``), from segmentation renders. Defect pixels include the hidden
383			probe cross of a normal brick.
384			"""
385			out = {}
386			self.renderer.enable_segmentation_rendering()
387			for key, opt in (("", self._all_groups), ("_full", self._brick_only))[: 2 if full else 1]:
388				self.renderer.update_scene(self.data, camera, scene_option=opt)
389				seg = self.renderer.render()
390				if crop is not None:
391					x, y, w, h = crop
392					seg = seg[y : y + h, x : x + w]
393				geom = np.where(seg[..., 1] == self._obj_geom, seg[..., 0], -1)
394				out[f"defect{key}"] = int(np.count_nonzero(self._is_defect[geom]))
395				out[f"brick{key}"] = int(np.count_nonzero(self._is_brick[geom]))
396			self.renderer.disable_segmentation_rendering()
397			return out

399		def robot_min_z(self) -> float:
400			"""Lowest point of the moving links' collision geometry (oriented bounding boxes), metres above the table."""
401			g = self.link_geoms
402			rot = self.data.geom_xmat[g].reshape(-1, 3, 3)
403			aabb = self.model.geom_aabb[g]
404			centre_z = self.data.geom_xpos[g, 2] + np.einsum("nj,nj->n", rot[:, 2, :], aabb[:, :3])
405			return float(np.min(centre_z - np.einsum("nj,nj->n", np.abs(rot[:, 2, :]), aabb[:, 3:])))

410			rot = self.data.xmat[self.brick_body].reshape(3, 3)
411			return self.data.xpos[self.brick_body] + rot @ centre, rot @ normal

419		def _ray_world_z(self, cid: int, shape: tuple[int, int]) -> np.ndarray:
420			"""World z of each pixel's viewing ray at unit depth along the optical axis.
421	
422			It depends only on the camera's orientation and focal length, so it is computed once and reused for as long
423			as the camera does not move: an episode renders hundreds of frames through one fixed top camera.
424			"""
425			mat = self.data.cam_xmat[cid]
426			f = self.model.cam_intrinsic[cid][0] / self.model.cam_sensorsize[cid][0] * RENDER_SIZE[0]
427			key = (cid, shape, float(f), mat.tobytes())
428			if self._ray_z is None or self._ray_z[0] != key:
429				hgt, wid = shape
430				u, v = np.meshgrid(np.arange(wid) + 0.5, np.arange(hgt) + 0.5)
431				ray = np.stack([(u - wid / 2) / f, -(v - hgt / 2) / f, -np.ones_like(u)], axis=-1)
432				self._ray_z = (key, np.ascontiguousarray((ray @ mat.reshape(3, 3).T)[..., 2]))
433			return self._ray_z[1]
434	
435		def height(self, camera: str, crop: tuple[int, int, int, int] | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
436			"""Height above the table per pixel of ``camera`` and a validity mask, optionally only inside ``crop``."""
437			self.renderer.enable_depth_rendering()
438			self.renderer.update_scene(self.data, camera)
439			depth = self.renderer.render()
440			self.renderer.disable_depth_rendering()
441			cid = self.camera_id(camera)
442			ray_z = self._ray_world_z(cid, depth.shape)
443			if crop is not None:
444				x, y, w, h = crop
445				depth, ray_z = depth[y : y + h, x : x + w], ray_z[y : y + h, x : x + w]
446			world_z = self.data.cam_xpos[cid][2] + ray_z * depth.astype(np.float64)
447			valid = depth < 5.0
448			return world_z, valid
449	
450		def top_images(self, rng: np.random.Generator | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
451			"""(top_rgb_v2, top_depth_v2) cropped like the depth bridge."""
452			x, y, w, h = TOP_CROP
453			rgb = self.rgb("top")[y : y + h, x : x + w]
454			z, valid = self.height("top", TOP_CROP)
455			if self.sensor_noise is not None and rng is not None:
456				top_pose = self._cam_poses.get("top")
457				if top_pose is None:
458					raise ValueError("top CameraPose must be set before applying camera-frame D415 depth noise")
459				rgb = degrade_rgb(rgb, rng, self.sensor_noise)
460				z, valid = degrade_depth_height(
461					z, valid, top_pose, rng, self.sensor_noise, crop=TOP_CROP, full_shape=TOP_FULL
462				)
463			return rgb, layered_height_image(z, valid)

"""Shared constants of the SO-101 sorting cell: joints, calibration, camera crop, depth encoding, cell geometry.

Both simulators (``digital_twin_armigo.mujoco_cell`` and the Isaac Lab stages in ``scripts/isaac``) read these, so
they agree on units and on the layout of dataset sort-depth-v2. Everything is in the robot base frame (metres, table
top at z = 0) unless a name says otherwise.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ASSETS_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "assets"
SIM_ASSETS_DIR = ASSETS_DIR / "meshes"
SO101_MJCF_DIR = ASSETS_DIR / "so101_mjcf"
CONFIG_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "config" / "sim"

FPS = 30
JOINTS = ("shoulder_pan", "shoulder_lift", "elbow_flex", "wrist_flex", "wrist_roll", "gripper")
STATE_NAMES = [f"{j}.pos" for j in JOINTS]
TASKS = {
	"green": "Pick up the brick and place it in the green bowl.",
	"pink": "Pick up the brick and place it in the pink bowl.",
}
PHASES = ("rest", "approach", "grasp", "lift", "show_move", "show_hold", "handoff", "place", "return")

# Follower calibration used for sort-depth-v2 (Studio project robot payload, ticks).
CALIBRATION = {
	"shoulder_pan": (1267, 3200),
	"shoulder_lift": (894, 3251),
	"elbow_flex": (849, 3045),
	"wrist_flex": (788, 3115),
	"wrist_roll": (2040, 3961),
	"gripper": (2041, 3508),
}
# Joint zero offsets from the camera-based joint calibration (robot.json), degrees: model = reading + offset.
OFFSETS_DEG = {"shoulder_lift": 1.5816, "elbow_flex": -4.6851, "wrist_flex": -1.3997}
TICKS_PER_DEG = 4096 / 360
GRIPPER_RAD = (-0.17453, 1.74533)  # Menagerie gripper range; assumed 0 = closed, 100 = open
# Rest pose in Studio's normalised units (body joints -100…100, gripper 0…100).
REST_U = (4.1, -98.7, 99.3, -98.2, 24.1, 33.7)
# Standard holding pose between inspection and placement: the same joint target in every episode (radians: pan,
# lift, elbow, wrist flex, wrist roll), so pick-and-inspect and place skills can be cut from one episode. Gripper
# frame at about (0.34, 0.00, 0.21) m, jaws tilted 45 deg down.
HANDOFF_Q = (0.0, 0.2, -0.9, 1.5, 0.0)

# Top camera (D415 colour view): rendered at TOP_FULL and cropped to TOP_CROP = (x, y, width, height), as the depth
# bridge does (``--crop 96 0 512 416``).
TOP_FULL = (640, 480)
TOP_CROP = (96, 0, 512, 416)
# Depth bridge ``layers`` encoding: R = height above the table 0 → FINE_MAX_M, G = 0 → COARSE_MAX_M, B = validity.
FINE_MAX_M = 0.04
COARSE_MAX_M = 0.30
# Depth bridge plane-v2: camera 0.508 m above the table, optical axis 25.8 deg from vertical.
PLANE_HEIGHT_M = 0.508
PLANE_TILT_DEG = math.degrees(math.acos(0.8996))
# Dataset image shapes (height, width, channels) per camera key.
CAMERA_SHAPES = {
	"front": [480, 640, 3],
	"top_rgb_v2": [416, 512, 3],
	"top_depth_v2": [416, 512, 3],
	"wrist": [480, 640, 3],
}

# Real cell: plates about 20 cm across, Duplo-size bricks (2x2: 31.8 mm square, 19.2 mm high; 2x4: 63.6 mm long).
BOWL_R = 0.10
BOWL_H = 0.022
DUPLO_2X2 = (0.0318, 0.0318, 0.0192)
DUPLO_2X3 = (0.0477, 0.0318, 0.0192)
DUPLO_2X4 = (0.0636, 0.0318, 0.0192)
STUD_PITCH = 0.016
BRICK_COLOURS = ((0.95, 0.4, 0.05), (0.95, 0.8, 0.1), (0.1, 0.45, 0.85), (0.85, 0.1, 0.1), (0.55, 0.8, 0.15))
# Printed markers seen in the cell (defect_sorter.markers): id, black-square side in metres.
CELL_MARKERS = {10: 0.040, 11: 0.040, 16: 0.060, 17: 0.060}

1	"""One episode's MuJoCo model: stepping with the assisted grasp, and renderers for the dataset cameras."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import os
6	from pathlib import Path
7	from typing import Self
8	
9	import numpy as np
10	
11	from ..camera import CameraPose
12	from ..constants import JOINTS, TOP_CROP, TOP_FULL
13	from ..depth import layered_height_image
14	from ..physics import PhysicsSpec, brick_spec_for_size
15	from ..presentation import face_frame
16	from ..sensor_noise import D415NoiseCfg, degrade_depth_height, degrade_rgb
17	from ._mj import mujoco
18	from .layout import Layout
19	from .scene import PROBE_GROUP, SUBSTEPS, scene_xml, write_marker_textures
20	
21	GRASP_RADIUS_M = 0.03
22	RELEASE_MAX_SPEED = 0.6  # m/s, brick speed cap for RELEASE_SETTLE_FRAMES frames after the jaws open
23	RELEASE_SETTLE_FRAMES = 15
24	RENDER_SIZE = (640, 480)  # width, height of every rendered camera
25	
26	
27	class Cell:
28		"""One episode's MuJoCo model with renderers for the dataset cameras.
29	
30		Ids and addresses that the per-frame and per-IK-iteration code needs are resolved once here: looking them up by
31		name (``model.joint(name)``, ``mj_name2id``) inside those loops costs more than the kinematics they wrap.
32		"""
33	
34		def __init__(
35			self,
36			layout: Layout,
37			menagerie: Path,
38			physics: PhysicsSpec | None = None,
39			dynamic_clutter: bool = False,
40			assisted_grasp: bool = True,
41			mass_scale: float = 1.0,
42			friction_scale: float = 1.0,
43			render_enabled: bool = True,
44			sensor_noise: D415NoiseCfg | None = None,
45		) -> None:
46			write_marker_textures(menagerie, {m[0] for m in layout.markers})
47			# The scene includes so101.xml by relative path, so it is compiled from a file next to it.
48			path = menagerie / f"_sorting_cell_{os.getpid()}.xml"
49			path.write_text(
50				scene_xml(
51					layout,
52					physics=physics,
53					dynamic_clutter=dynamic_clutter,
54					mass_scale=mass_scale,
55					friction_scale=friction_scale,
56				),
57				encoding="utf-8",
58			)
59			try:
60				self.model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path(str(path))
61			finally:
62				path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
63			self.layout = layout
64			self.physics = physics
65			self.assisted_grasp = assisted_grasp
66			self.sensor_noise = sensor_noise
67			self.data = mujoco.MjData(self.model)
68			self.renderer = mujoco.Renderer(self.model, RENDER_SIZE[1], RENDER_SIZE[0]) if render_enabled else None
69			self.held: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None = None
70			self.settle_frames = 0
71			m = self.model
72	
73			def body(name: str) -> int:
74				return mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, name)
75	
76			self.site = mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE, "gripperframe")
77			self.brick_body = body("brick")
78			self.grip_body = body("gripper")
79			self.jaw_body = body("moving_jaw_so101_v1")
80			# arm joints in JOINTS order: qpos addresses, dof (Jacobian column) addresses and position limits
81			self.qadr = [int(m.joint(j).qposadr[0]) for j in JOINTS]
82			self.dofadr = [int(m.joint(j).dofadr[0]) for j in JOINTS]
83			self.jnt_range = m.jnt_range[[m.joint(j).id for j in JOINTS]].copy()
84			self.brick_qadr = int(m.joint("brick").qposadr[0])
85			self.brick_dofadr = int(m.joint("brick").dofadr[0])
86			self._cam_ids = {m.camera(c).name: c for c in range(m.ncam)}
87	
88			robot_root = m.body_rootid[self.grip_body]
89			self.robot_geoms = np.array(
90				[g for g in range(m.ngeom) if m.body_rootid[m.geom_bodyid[g]] == robot_root and m.geom_group[g] == 3]
91			)
92			# links that move with the shoulder lift (the base and shoulder sit on the table by design)
93			lift_body = m.jnt_bodyid[m.joint("shoulder_lift").id]
94	
95			def moves(b: int) -> bool:
96				while b > 0:
97					if b == lift_body:
98						return True
99					b = m.body_parentid[b]
100				return False
101	
102			self.link_geoms = np.array([g for g in self.robot_geoms if moves(m.geom_bodyid[g])])
103			self.defect_geoms = np.array(
104				[mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM, f"defect_{k}") for k in range(2)], dtype=int
105			)
106			self.brick_geoms = np.array([g for g in range(m.ngeom) if m.geom_bodyid[g] == self.brick_body])
107			self.fixed_jaw_geoms = {
108				g for g in range(m.ngeom) if m.geom_bodyid[g] == self.grip_body and m.geom_group[g] in (3, 4)
109			}
110			self.moving_jaw_geoms = {
111				g for g in range(m.ngeom) if m.geom_bodyid[g] == self.jaw_body and m.geom_group[g] in (3, 4)
112			}
113			self.non_jaw_robot_geoms = {
114				int(g)
115				for g in self.link_geoms
116				if int(g) not in self.fixed_jaw_geoms and int(g) not in self.moving_jaw_geoms
117			}
118			self.robot_all_geoms = {g for g in range(m.ngeom) if m.body_rootid[m.geom_bodyid[g]] == robot_root}
119	
120			if physics is not None:
121				self._apply_physics_spec(physics, mass_scale=mass_scale, friction_scale=friction_scale)
122	
123			# Segmentation lookups indexed by geom id; the extra last entry stays False and takes index -1 (not a geom).
124			self._is_defect = np.zeros(m.ngeom + 1, bool)
125			self._is_defect[self.defect_geoms] = True
126			self._is_brick = np.zeros(m.ngeom + 1, bool)
127			self._is_brick[self.brick_geoms] = True
128			# A plain int: comparing an array with the pybind11 enum itself runs a Python call per pixel (about 65 ms
129			# for one cropped image against 0.04 ms).
130			self._obj_geom = int(mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM)
131			self._all_groups = mujoco.MjvOption()
132			self._all_groups.geomgroup[:] = 1
133			self._all_groups.geomgroup[3:5] = 0
134			self._brick_only = mujoco.MjvOption()
135			self._brick_only.geomgroup[:] = 0
136			self._brick_only.geomgroup[0] = 1
137			self._brick_only.geomgroup[PROBE_GROUP] = 1
138			self._ray_z: tuple[tuple, np.ndarray] | None = None
139			self._cam_poses: dict[str, CameraPose] = {}
140			if layout.top is not None:
141				self._cam_poses["top"] = layout.top
142			if layout.front is not None:
143				self._cam_poses["front"] = layout.front
144	
145		def _apply_physics_spec(self, physics: PhysicsSpec, mass_scale: float, friction_scale: float) -> None:
146			"""Align MuJoCo actuator gains, joint dynamics, and surface friction with :class:`PhysicsSpec`."""
147			m = self.model
148			for idx, jname in enumerate(JOINTS):
149				act_id = mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR, jname)
150				spec = physics.gripper_actuator if jname == "gripper" else physics.arm_actuator
151				m.actuator_gainprm[act_id, 0] = spec.stiffness
152				m.actuator_biasprm[act_id, 1] = -spec.stiffness
153				m.actuator_biasprm[act_id, 2] = -spec.damping
154				m.actuator_forcerange[act_id] = (-spec.effort_limit, spec.effort_limit)
155				dof = self.dofadr[idx]
156				m.dof_damping[dof] = spec.joint_damping
157				m.dof_frictionloss[dof] = spec.frictionloss
158				m.dof_armature[dof] = spec.armature
159	
160			# Surface frictions (MuJoCo combines contacts via max by default when priorities match)
161			for g in self.fixed_jaw_geoms | self.moving_jaw_geoms:
162				m.geom_priority[g] = 0
163				m.geom_friction[g] = (physics.gripper_pad.static_friction * friction_scale, 0.005, 0.0005)
164			table_gid = mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM, "table")
165			if table_gid >= 0:
166				m.geom_friction[table_gid] = (physics.table.dynamic_friction * friction_scale, 0.005, 0.0005)
167			for bname in ("green_bowl", "pink_bowl"):
168				bid = mujoco.mj_name2id(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, bname)
169				if bid >= 0:
170					for g in range(m.ngeom):
171						if m.geom_bodyid[g] == bid and m.geom_contype[g] != 0:
172							m.geom_friction[g] = (physics.plate.dynamic_friction * friction_scale, 0.005, 0.0005)
173			bspec = brick_spec_for_size(self.layout.brick_size, physics).scaled(mass_scale, friction_scale)
174			# Note: body_mass/inertia already set in MJCF _brick when physics is passed, ensure inertia matches scaled box
175			sx, sy, sz = self.layout.brick_size
176			m.body_mass[self.brick_body] = bspec.mass_kg
177			m.body_inertia[self.brick_body] = (
178				bspec.mass_kg * (sy**2 + sz**2) / 12.0,
179				bspec.mass_kg * (sx**2 + sz**2) / 12.0,
180				bspec.mass_kg * (sx**2 + sy**2) / 12.0,
181			)
182	
183		def close(self) -> None:
184			"""Release the renderer's GL context."""
185			if self.renderer is not None:
186				self.renderer.close()
187	
188		def __enter__(self) -> Self:
189			return self
190	
191		def __exit__(self, *exc: object) -> None:
192			self.close()
193	
194		def camera_id(self, name: str) -> int:
195			return self._cam_ids[name]
196	
197		def set_joints(self, q: np.ndarray) -> None:
198			self.data.qpos[self.qadr] = q
199			self.data.ctrl[:6] = q
200			mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)
201	
202		def set_camera(self, name: str, pose: CameraPose) -> None:
203			"""Move an existing camera in place (no recompilation)."""
204			cid = self.camera_id(name)
205			right, up = pose.axes()
206			mat = np.column_stack([right, up, np.cross(right, up)])
207			quat = np.zeros(4)
208			mujoco.mju_mat2Quat(quat, mat.flatten())
209			self.model.cam_pos[cid] = (pose.x, pose.y, pose.height)
210			self.model.cam_quat[cid] = quat
211			width = self.model.cam_resolution[cid][0]
212			self.model.cam_intrinsic[cid][:2] = pose.focal_px * self.model.cam_sensorsize[cid][0] / width
213			self._cam_poses[name] = pose
214			mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)
215	
216		def joints(self) -> np.ndarray:
217			return self.data.qpos[self.qadr].copy()
218	
219		def step(self, ctrl: np.ndarray) -> None:
220			self.data.ctrl[:6] = ctrl
221			if self.settle_frames <= 0:
222				mujoco.mj_step(self.model, self.data, nstep=SUBSTEPS)
223				return
224			# Just after release the brick may still overlap a jaw or the clutter it was held against; cap its speed for
225			# a few frames so penetration is resolved as a drop instead of an ejection.
226			vadr = self.brick_dofadr
227			for _ in range(SUBSTEPS):
228				mujoco.mj_step(self.model, self.data)
229				v = self.data.qvel[vadr : vadr + 6]
230				v[:3] *= min(1.0, RELEASE_MAX_SPEED / max(float(np.linalg.norm(v[:3])), 1e-9))
231				v[3:] *= min(1.0, 10.0 / max(float(np.linalg.norm(v[3:])), 1e-9))
232			self.settle_frames -= 1
233	
234		def update_grasp(self, gripper_cmd: float) -> None:
235			"""Assisted grasp when ``self.assisted_grasp`` is True; pure contact friction otherwise."""
236			if not self.assisted_grasp:
237				return
238			d = self.data
239			if self.held is None:
240				closed = gripper_cmd < 0.0 and d.qpos[self.qadr[5]] < 0.35
241				near = np.linalg.norm(self.brick_pos() - d.site_xpos[self.site]) < GRASP_RADIUS_M
242				if closed and near:
243					rot_g = d.xmat[self.grip_body].reshape(3, 3)
244					rot_b = d.xmat[self.brick_body].reshape(3, 3)
245					self.held = (rot_g.T @ (self.brick_pos() - d.xpos[self.grip_body]), rot_g.T @ rot_b)
246				return
247			if gripper_cmd > 0.3:
248				self.held = None
249				self.settle_frames = RELEASE_SETTLE_FRAMES
250				return
251			d.qvel[self.brick_dofadr : self.brick_dofadr + 6] = 0.0
252			self.place_held()
253	
254		def tcp_pos(self) -> np.ndarray:
255			return self.data.site_xpos[self.site].copy()
256	
257		def brick_pos(self) -> np.ndarray:
258			return self.data.xpos[self.brick_body].copy()
259	
260		def brick_quat_xyzw(self) -> np.ndarray:
261			"""Brick orientation quaternion in (x, y, z, w) convention."""
262			wxyz = self.data.xquat[self.brick_body]
263			return np.array([wxyz[1], wxyz[2], wxyz[3], wxyz[0]], dtype=np.float64)
264	
265		def brick_vel(self) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
266			"""World linear (m/s) and angular (rad/s) velocity of the brick."""
267			v = self.data.qvel[self.brick_dofadr : self.brick_dofadr + 6]
268			return v[:3].copy(), v[3:].copy()
269

"""Pure-physics pick → show → handoff → place episodes on the MuJoCo cell: a per-frame recorder and a closed-loop
expert.

``PhysicsEpisode`` owns the 240 Hz stepping and the per-frame telemetry the audited evaluator reads (the open-loop
benchmark in ``scripts/bench_cross_engine.py`` replays its joint targets through it). ``ClosedLoopExpert`` reads
privileged simulator state every frame and returns the next joint target; it acts only through that target, which
goes through the same :class:`~digital_twin_armigo.physics.ActuatorCommandFilter` as the open-loop plan.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math

import numpy as np

from ..constants import FPS
from ..physics import ActuatorCommandFilter, NonIdealityCfg
from ._mj import mujoco
from .cell import Cell

PHYSICS_HZ = 240
SUBSTEPS = PHYSICS_HZ // FPS  # 8 substeps @ 240 Hz per 30 Hz frame
WARMUP_STEPS = 12


class PhysicsEpisode:
	"""Reset the cell for one pure-physics episode, step it one 30 Hz frame at a time and log telemetry.

	``telemetry()`` returns the arrays the audited evaluator consumes (see ``_evaluate_mj_rollout``): one row per
	frame, sampled after the frame's substeps.
	"""

	def __init__(
		self,
		cell: Cell,
		q_start: np.ndarray,
		brick_xy: tuple[float, float] = (0.26, 0.0),
		brick_yaw_deg: float = 0.0,
		non_ideal: NonIdealityCfg | None = None,
	) -> None:
		self.cell = cell
		cell.model.opt.timestep = 1.0 / PHYSICS_HZ
		cell.set_joints(q_start)
		cell.data.qvel[:] = 0.0
		yaw_rad = math.radians(brick_yaw_deg)
		b_quat = (0.0, 0.0, math.sin(yaw_rad / 2.0), math.cos(yaw_rad / 2.0))
		cell.set_brick_pose(
			np.array([brick_xy[0], brick_xy[1], cell.layout.brick_size[2] / 2.0 + 0.0005]), np.array(b_quat)
		)
		cell.data.ctrl[:6] = q_start
		for _ in range(WARMUP_STEPS):
			mujoco.mj_step(cell.model, cell.data)

		self.filt = ActuatorCommandFilter(non_ideal, n_joints=6, fps=FPS) if non_ideal is not None else None
		if self.filt is not None:
			self.filt.reset(q_start)
		self._logs: dict[str, list] = {
			k: []
			for k in (
				"q_cmd",
				"qpos",
				"tcp_pos",
				"ee_quat",
				"brick_pos",
				"brick_quat",
				"brick_vel",
				"brick_ang_vel",
				"jaw_forces",
				"pinch_normal",
				"pinch_tangential",
				"unintended_forces",
				"substep_unintended",
				"actuator_torques",
			)
		}

	@property
	def n_frames(self) -> int:
		return len(self._logs["q_cmd"])

	def step(self, target: np.ndarray) -> None:

"""Pure-physics pick → show → handoff → place episodes on the MuJoCo cell: a per-frame recorder and a closed-loop
expert.

``PhysicsEpisode`` owns the 240 Hz stepping and the per-frame telemetry the audited evaluator reads (the open-loop
benchmark in ``scripts/bench_cross_engine.py`` replays its joint targets through it). ``ClosedLoopExpert`` reads
privileged simulator state every frame and returns the next joint target; it acts only through that target, which
goes through the same :class:`~digital_twin_armigo.physics.ActuatorCommandFilter` as the open-loop plan.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math

import numpy as np

from ..constants import FPS
from ..physics import ActuatorCommandFilter, NonIdealityCfg
from ._mj import mujoco
from .cell import Cell

PHYSICS_HZ = 240
SUBSTEPS = PHYSICS_HZ // FPS  # 8 substeps @ 240 Hz per 30 Hz frame
WARMUP_STEPS = 12


class PhysicsEpisode:
	"""Reset the cell for one pure-physics episode, step it one 30 Hz frame at a time and log telemetry.

	``telemetry()`` returns the arrays the audited evaluator consumes (see ``_evaluate_mj_rollout``): one row per
	frame, sampled after the frame's substeps.
	"""

	def __init__(
		self,
		cell: Cell,
		q_start: np.ndarray,
		brick_xy: tuple[float, float] = (0.26, 0.0),
		brick_yaw_deg: float = 0.0,
		non_ideal: NonIdealityCfg | None = None,
	) -> None:
		self.cell = cell
		cell.model.opt.timestep = 1.0 / PHYSICS_HZ
		cell.set_joints(q_start)
		cell.data.qvel[:] = 0.0
		yaw_rad = math.radians(brick_yaw_deg)
		b_quat = (0.0, 0.0, math.sin(yaw_rad / 2.0), math.cos(yaw_rad / 2.0))
		cell.set_brick_pose(
			np.array([brick_xy[0], brick_xy[1], cell.layout.brick_size[2] / 2.0 + 0.0005]), np.array(b_quat)
		)
		cell.data.ctrl[:6] = q_start
		for _ in range(WARMUP_STEPS):
			mujoco.mj_step(cell.model, cell.data)

		self.filt = ActuatorCommandFilter(non_ideal, n_joints=6, fps=FPS) if non_ideal is not None else None
		if self.filt is not None:
			self.filt.reset(q_start)
		self._logs: dict[str, list] = {
			k: []
			for k in (
				"q_cmd",
				"qpos",
				"tcp_pos",
				"ee_quat",
				"brick_pos",
				"brick_quat",
				"brick_vel",
				"brick_ang_vel",
				"jaw_forces",
				"pinch_normal",
				"pinch_tangential",
				"unintended_forces",
				"substep_unintended",
				"actuator_torques",
			)
		}

	@property
	def n_frames(self) -> int:
		return len(self._logs["q_cmd"])

	def step(self, target: np.ndarray) -> None:
		"""Advance one 30 Hz frame towards the 6-D joint position ``target`` (through the command filter)."""
		cell = self.cell
		q_cmd = self.filt.step_command(target, cell.joints()) if self.filt is not None else target
		sub = cell.step_with_telemetry(q_cmd, substeps=SUBSTEPS)
		log = self._logs
		log["q_cmd"].append(q_cmd.copy())
		log["qpos"].append(cell.joints())
		log["tcp_pos"].append(cell.tcp_pos())
		wxyz = cell.data.xquat[cell.grip_body]
		log["ee_quat"].append(np.array([wxyz[1], wxyz[2], wxyz[3], wxyz[0]], dtype=np.float64))
		log["brick_pos"].append(cell.brick_pos())
		log["brick_quat"].append(cell.brick_quat_xyzw())
		lv, av = cell.brick_vel()
		log["brick_vel"].append(lv)
		log["brick_ang_vel"].append(av)
		log["jaw_forces"].append(sub["jaw_total"][-1])
		log["pinch_normal"].append(sub["jaw_normal"].mean(axis=1))
		log["pinch_tangential"].append(sub["jaw_tangential"].mean(axis=1))
		log["unintended_forces"].append(float(sub["unintended"][-1]))
		log["substep_unintended"].append(sub["unintended"])
		log["actuator_torques"].append(sub["torques"][np.argmax(np.abs(sub["torques"]), axis=0), np.arange(6)])

	def last(self, key: str):
		"""The most recent logged row of ``key``."""
		return self._logs[key][-1]

	def telemetry(self) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
		out = {"t": np.arange(self.n_frames, dtype=np.float64) / float(FPS)}
		out.update({k: np.array(v) for k, v in self._logs.items()})
		return out

# --- closed-loop expert -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExpertParams:
	"""Every tunable number of :class:`ClosedLoopExpert`. Lengths in metres, angles in radians unless the name says
	degrees, durations in seconds, forces in newtons, speeds in metres per second."""

	hold_g: float = 0.06  # gripper command while pinching (rad); the gripper torque saturates below contact
	rest_s: float = 0.3  # initial hold at rest
	ready_q: tuple[float, float, float, float, float] = (0.0, -0.35, 0.25, 1.35, 0.0)  # intermediate arm pose (rad)
	ready_move_s: float = 0.8
	hover_z_m: float = 0.06  # gripper-frame height above the grasp point before descending
	hover_move_s: float = 1.4
	pregrasp_dz_m: float = 0.02  # height above the grasp height where the final descent starts
	descend_s: float = 1.0
	final_descend_s: float = 0.6
	grasp_tcp_z_m: float = 0.008  # gripper-frame height at the grasp
	pad_clearance_m: float = 0.002  # gap between the fixed-jaw pad and the brick face before closing
	servo_tol_m: float = 0.0008  # gripper-frame position error accepted before closing
	servo_gain: float = 0.6  # fraction of the measured gripper-frame error fed back into the target per frame

	servo_max_frames: int = 30
	close_s: float = 0.5  # gripper closing ramp
	clamp_force_n: float = 1.5  # both jaws' normal force needed for a clamp
	clamp_still_speed_mps: float = 0.005  # brick speed below which it counts as stationary
	clamp_still_frames: int = 4  # consecutive clamped, stationary frames before lifting
	clamp_timeout_frames: int = 45  # frames after the closing ramp before a grasp attempt is abandoned
	max_grasp_retries: int = 2
	reopen_s: float = 0.5
	lift_z_m: float = 0.12
	lift_s: float = 1.2
	show_flex: float = 0.65  # wrist flex of the show poses (rad)
	show_roll_deg: tuple[float, float, float] = (-35.0, 0.0, 35.0)
	show_move_s: float = 0.9
	show_hold_s: float = 0.4
	handoff_move_s: float = 1.5
	handoff_hold_s: float = 0.6
	transfer_z_m: float = 0.12  # gripper-frame height when moving over the bowl
	transfer_s: float = 1.8
	release_clearance_m: float = 0.004  # brick bottom above the bowl floor at release
	place_descend_s: float = 1.2
	open_ramp_s: float = 1.0  # gripper opening ramp at release
	settle_speed_mps: float = 0.01
	settle_frames: int = 6
	settle_timeout_s: float = 1.5
	retreat_dz_m: float = 0.06
	retreat_s: float = 0.8
	return_s: float = 1.2
	final_hold_s: float = 0.9
	lost_force_n: float = 0.02  # a jaw below this normal force has lost contact
	lost_frames: int = 10  # consecutive frames without dual contact after lift: brick lost
	max_frames: int = 900
	bowl_floor_z_m: float = 0.003
	bowl_margin_m: float = 0.012  # keep the brick's corners this far inside the bowl radius
	clutter_clearance_m: float = 0.03  # preferred distance of the release point from clutter bricks


class _Kinematics:
	"""A private ``MjData`` on the cell's model for IK and forward kinematics: the simulation state is never
	touched. Exposes the attributes the solvers in :mod:`.ik` read."""

	def __init__(self, cell: Cell) -> None:
		self.model = cell.model
		self.data = mujoco.MjData(cell.model)
		self.data.qpos[:] = cell.data.qpos
		mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)
		for name in ("site", "qadr", "dofadr", "jnt_range", "jaw_body", "grip_body"):
			setattr(self, name, getattr(cell, name))

	def site_pose(self, q: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
		"""Gripper-frame position and rotation matrix at joint angles ``q``."""
		self.data.qpos[self.qadr] = q
		mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.model, self.data)
		return self.data.site_xpos[self.site].copy(), self.data.site_xmat[self.site].reshape(3, 3).copy()


def _geom_points(model, gid: int) -> np.ndarray:
	"""Vertices (mesh) or bounding-box corners (primitives) of geom ``gid`` in its own frame."""
	t = model.geom_type[gid]
	s = model.geom_size[gid]
	signs = np.array([(x, y, z) for x in (-1.0, 1.0) for y in (-1.0, 1.0) for z in (-1.0, 1.0)])
	if t == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_MESH:
		mid = model.geom_dataid[gid]
		a, n = model.mesh_vertadr[mid], model.mesh_vertnum[mid]
		return model.mesh_vert[a : a + n].astype(np.float64)
	if t == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_BOX:
		return signs * s
	if t == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_SPHERE:
		return signs * s[0]
	if t == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_CAPSULE:
		return signs * np.array([s[0], s[0], s[1] + s[0]])
	return signs * model.geom_rbound[gid]


def jaw_pad_faces(cell: Cell, kin: _Kinematics, q: np.ndarray, band: tuple[float, float]) -> tuple[float, float]:
	"""Inner faces of the fixed and moving jaw along the gripper frame's z axis (fixed → moving jaw), metres.

	Computed from the compiled collision geoms at joint angles ``q``, keeping only geometry whose gripper-frame x
	(the approach axis, pointing down) lies in ``band`` — the slab the brick occupies. Returns the largest z of the
	fixed jaw and the smallest z of the moving jaw (``inf`` when the moving jaw is clear of the slab).
	"""
	pos, rot = kin.site_pose(q)
	m, d = kin.model, kin.data
	faces = []
	for geoms, pick in ((cell.fixed_jaw_geoms, np.max), (cell.moving_jaw_geoms, np.min)):
		pts = []
		for gid in sorted(geoms):
			w = d.geom_xpos[gid] + _geom_points(m, gid) @ d.geom_xmat[gid].reshape(3, 3).T
			pts.append((w - pos) @ rot)
		p = np.vstack(pts)
		p = p[(p[:, 0] >= band[0]) & (p[:, 0] <= band[1])]
		faces.append(float(pick(p[:, 2])) if len(p) else (np.inf if pick is np.min else -np.inf))
	return faces[0], faces[1]


def _quat_xyzw_to_mat(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
	x, y, z, w = q
	return np.array(
		[
			[1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z), 2 * (x * y - z * w), 2 * (x * z + y * w)],
			[2 * (x * y + z * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z), 2 * (y * z - x * w)],
			[2 * (x * z - y * w), 2 * (y * z + x * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y)],
		]
	)


def _min_jerk(n: int) -> np.ndarray:
	s = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n)
	return 10 * s**3 - 15 * s**4 + 6 * s**5


class ClosedLoopExpert:
	"""Per-frame pick → show → handoff → place policy on privileged simulator state.

	``act(obs)`` takes the current observation (``q``, ``tcp``, ``brick_pos``, ``brick_quat``, ``brick_vel``,
	``jaw_normal``) and returns ``(joint_target, phase)``; ``done`` turns True when the episode script has ended.
	"""

	def __init__(self, cell: Cell, q_start: np.ndarray, bowl_xy: tuple[float, float], params: ExpertParams) -> None:
		self.cell = cell
		self.p = params
		self.q_start = np.asarray(q_start, dtype=np.float64).copy()
		self.bowl_xy = np.asarray(bowl_xy, dtype=np.float64)
		self.kin = _Kinematics(cell)
		self.size = tuple(cell.layout.brick_size)
		self.obs: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
		self.last = self.q_start.copy()
		self.grasp_retries = 0
		self.lost = False
		self.done = False
		self._gen = self._script()
		lo, hi = cell.jnt_range[:, 0], cell.jnt_range[:, 1]
		self._lo, self._hi = lo.copy(), hi.copy()

	# -- plumbing --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	def act(self, obs: dict[str, np.ndarray]) -> tuple[np.ndarray, str]:
		self.obs = obs
		try:
			target, phase = next(self._gen)
		except StopIteration:
			self.done = True
			return self.last.copy(), "return"
		target = np.clip(target, self._lo, self._hi)
		self.last = target.copy()
		return target, phase

	def _frames(self, secs: float) -> int:
		return max(1, round(secs * FPS))

	def _move(self, q_to: np.ndarray, secs: float, phase: str):
		q_from = self.last.copy()
		n = max(2, self._frames(secs) + 1)
		for s in _min_jerk(n)[1:]:
			yield q_from + s * (q_to - q_from), phase

	def _hold(self, secs: float, phase: str):
		for _ in range(self._frames(secs)):
			yield self.last.copy(), phase

	def _ik(self, target: np.ndarray, q0: np.ndarray, roll: float) -> np.ndarray:
		from .ik import ik_reach

		q = ik_reach(self.kin, np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float64), q0, roll)
		q[5] = q0[5]
		return q

	def _dual(self) -> bool:
		f = self.obs.get("jaw_normal", np.zeros(2))
		return bool(f[0] > self.p.lost_force_n and f[1] > self.p.lost_force_n)

	# -- grasp geometry --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	def _grasp_plan(self) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float, np.ndarray]:
		"""Gripper-frame target, wrist roll and the grasp joint angles for the brick's current pose."""
		p = self.p
		bpos = self.obs["brick_pos"]
		rot_b = _quat_xyzw_to_mat(self.obs["brick_quat"])
		short = rot_b[:2, 1] / max(np.linalg.norm(rot_b[:2, 1]), 1e-9)
		half_w = 0.5 * self.size[1]
		q_seed = np.array([*p.ready_q, p.open_g])
		q_hover = self._ik(np.array([bpos[0], bpos[1], p.hover_z_m]), q_seed, 0.0)
		# roll that lines the gripper-frame z axis (fixed → moving jaw) up with the short axis, either sign
		lo, hi = self.cell.jnt_range[4]
		best = (-np.inf, 0.0)
		for roll in np.linspace(lo, hi, 721):
			q_hover[4] = roll
			_, rot = self.kin.site_pose(q_hover)
			z = rot[:2, 2]
			score = abs(float(z @ short)) / max(np.linalg.norm(z), 1e-9) - 0.02 * abs(roll)
			if score > best[0]:
				best = (score, float(roll))
		roll = best[1]
		# iterate: the pad faces and the jaw axis depend on the solved pose
		target = np.array([bpos[0], bpos[1], p.grasp_tcp_z_m])
		q = q_hover.copy()
		q[4] = roll
		for _ in range(3):
			q = self._ik(target, q, roll)
			q[5] = p.open_g
			_, rot = self.kin.site_pose(q)
			zdir = rot[:, 2].copy()
			zdir[2] = 0.0
			zdir /= max(np.linalg.norm(zdir), 1e-9)
			band = (p.grasp_tcp_z_m - self.size[2] - 0.0 - bpos[2] + self.size[2] / 2.0, p.grasp_tcp_z_m)
			band = (-(bpos[2] + self.size[2] / 2.0 - p.grasp_tcp_z_m), p.grasp_tcp_z_m - (bpos[2] - self.size[2] / 2.0))
			fixed_face, moving_face = jaw_pad_faces(self.cell, self.kin, q, band)
			# brick centre sits at gripper-frame z = fixed_face + pad clearance + half width
			offset = -(fixed_face + p.pad_clearance_m + half_w)
			target = np.array([bpos[0] + offset * zdir[0], bpos[1] + offset * zdir[1], p.grasp_tcp_z_m])
		self.grasp_info = {"fixed_face_m": fixed_face, "moving_face_m": moving_face, "offset_m": offset}
		return target, roll, q

	# -- the episode script ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	def _servo(self, target: np.ndarray, q: np.ndarray, roll: float, phase: str):
		"""Hold the gripper frame at ``target``, feeding back the measured error, until within tolerance."""
		p = self.p
		corr = np.zeros(3)
		for _ in range(p.servo_max_frames):
			err = target - self.obs["tcp"]
			if np.linalg.norm(err) < p.servo_tol_m:
				break
			corr = np.clip(corr + p.servo_gain * err, -p.servo_max_correction_m, p.servo_max_correction_m)
			q_cmd = self._ik(target + corr, self.last, roll)
			yield q_cmd, phase
		return corr

	def _script(self):
		p = self.p
		yield from self._hold(p.rest_s, "rest")
		q = np.array([*p.ready_q, p.open_g])
		yield from self._move(q, p.ready_move_s, "approach")
		attempts = 0
		clamped = False
		phase = "approach"
		while True:
			target, roll, q_grasp = self._grasp_plan()
			hover = target + np.array([0.0, 0.0, p.hover_z_m - p.grasp_tcp_z_m])
			pre = target + np.array([0.0, 0.0, p.pregrasp_dz_m])
			q = self._ik(hover, self.last if attempts else q_grasp, roll)
			q[5] = p.open_g
			yield from self._move(q, p.hover_move_s, phase)
			q = self._ik(pre, q, roll)
			yield from self._move(q, p.descend_s, phase)
			q = self._ik(target, q, roll)
			yield from self._move(q, p.final_descend_s, "grasp")
			corr = yield from self._servo(target, q, roll, "grasp")
			q_hold = self.last.copy()
			q_closed = q_hold.copy()
			q_closed[5] = p.hold_g
			yield from self._move(q_closed, p.close_s, "grasp")
			still = 0
			for _ in range(p.clamp_timeout_frames):
				f = self.obs["jaw_normal"]
				v = float(np.linalg.norm(self.obs["brick_vel"]))
				still = still + 1 if (min(f) >= p.clamp_force_n and v < p.clamp_still_speed_mps) else 0
				if still >= p.clamp_still_frames:
					clamped = True
					break
				yield self.last.copy(), "grasp"
			if clamped or attempts >= p.max_grasp_retries:
				break
			attempts += 1
			self.grasp_retries = attempts
			phase = "grasp"
			q_open = self.last.copy()
			q_open[5] = p.open_g
			yield from self._move(q_open, p.reopen_s, "grasp")
			q_up = self._ik(self.obs["tcp"] + np.array([0.0, 0.0, p.hover_z_m - p.grasp_tcp_z_m]), self.last, roll)
			q_up[5] = p.open_g
			yield from self._move(q_up, p.descend_s, "grasp")
		self.corr = corr
		# lift
		lift_target = np.array([target[0], target[1], p.lift_z_m]) + corr
		q_lift = self._ik(lift_target, self.last, roll)
		q_lift[5] = p.hold_g
		yield from self._carry(self._move(q_lift, p.lift_s, "lift"))
		if not self.lost:
			for wr in p.show_roll_deg:
				q_show = q_lift.copy()
				q_show[3] = p.show_flex
				q_show[4] = math.radians(wr)
				yield from self._carry(self._move(q_show, p.show_move_s, "show_move"))
				yield from self._carry(self._hold(p.show_hold_s, "show_hold"))
				if self.lost:
					break
		if not self.lost:
			q_hand = np.array([*HANDOFF_Q, p.hold_g])
			yield from self._carry(self._move(q_hand, p.handoff_move_s, "handoff"))
			yield from self._carry(self._hold(p.handoff_hold_s, "handoff"))
		if not self.lost:
			yield from self._place(q_lift, roll)
		q_rest = self.q_start.copy()
		q_rest[5] = max(self.last[5], p.open_g) if not self.lost else p.open_g
		yield from self._move(q_rest, p.return_s, "return")
		yield from self._hold(p.final_hold_s, "return")

	def _carry(self, frames):
		"""Pass carry frames through, watching for a lost brick (no recovery: the episode just ends)."""
		for item in frames:
			if self.lost:
				return
			yield item
			self._no_dual = 0 if self._dual() else getattr(self, "_no_dual", 0) + 1
			if self._no_dual >= self.p.lost_frames:
				self.lost = True

	def _release_xy(self) -> np.ndarray:
		"""Release point: the bowl centre, or the point inside the bowl farthest from any clutter brick."""
		p = self.p
		m, d = self.cell.model, self.cell.data
		clutter = []
		for b in range(m.nbody):
			name = mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, b) or ""
			if name.startswith("clutter_"):
				clutter.append(d.xpos[b, :2].copy())
		if not clutter:
			return self.bowl_xy.copy()
		half_diag = 0.5 * math.hypot(self.size[0], self.size[1])
		r_max = max(BOWL_R - half_diag - p.bowl_margin_m, 0.0)
		best, best_score = self.bowl_xy.copy(), -np.inf
		for r in np.linspace(0.0, r_max, 6):
			for a in np.linspace(0.0, 2 * math.pi, 24, endpoint=False):
				c = self.bowl_xy + r * np.array([math.cos(a), math.sin(a)])
				dmin = min(float(np.linalg.norm(c - x)) for x in clutter)
				score = min(dmin, p.clutter_clearance_m + half_diag) - 0.1 * r
				if score > best_score:
					best, best_score = c, score
		return best

	def _place(self, q_lift: np.ndarray, roll: float):
		p = self.p
		rxy = self._release_xy()
		q = self._ik(np.array([rxy[0], rxy[1], p.transfer_z_m]), q_lift, roll)
		q[5] = p.hold_g
		yield from self._carry(self._move(q, p.transfer_s, "place"))
		if self.lost:
			return
		dz = self.obs["brick_pos"][2] - self.obs["tcp"][2]
		z_tcp = p.bowl_floor_z_m + p.release_clearance_m + self.size[2] / 2.0 - dz
		q = self._ik(np.array([rxy[0], rxy[1], z_tcp]), q, roll)
		q[5] = p.hold_g
		yield from self._carry(self._move(q, p.place_descend_s, "place"))
		if self.lost:
			return
		q_open = self.last.copy()
		q_open[5] = p.open_g
		yield from self._move(q_open, p.open_ramp_s, "place")
		still = 0
		for _ in range(self._frames(p.settle_timeout_s)):
			v = float(np.linalg.norm(self.obs["brick_vel"]))
			still = still + 1 if v < p.settle_speed_mps else 0
			if still >= p.settle_frames:
				break
			yield self.last.copy(), "place"
		q_up = self._ik(self.obs["tcp"] + np.array([0.0, 0.0, p.retreat_dz_m]), self.last, roll)
		q_up[5] = p.open_g
		yield from self._move(q_up, p.retreat_s, "place")


def _observe(cell: Cell, episode: PhysicsEpisode) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
	lv, _ = cell.brick_vel()
	jaw = episode.last("pinch_normal") if episode.n_frames else np.zeros(2)
	return {
		"q": cell.joints(),
		"tcp": cell.tcp_pos(),
		"brick_pos": cell.brick_pos(),
		"brick_quat": cell.brick_quat_xyzw(),
		"brick_vel": lv,
		"jaw_normal": np.asarray(jaw, dtype=np.float64),
	}


def episode_diagnostics(tel: dict[str, np.ndarray], phases: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float]:
	"""``grasp_push_mm``, ``jaw_normal_at_lift_N`` and ``release_peak_speed_mps`` from an episode's telemetry
	(``nan`` when the episode never reached the phase the metric needs)."""
	ph = np.asarray(phases)
	g = np.flatnonzero(ph == PHASES.index("grasp"))
	lift = np.flatnonzero(ph == PHASES.index("lift"))
	place = np.flatnonzero(ph == PHASES.index("place"))
	out = {"grasp_push_mm": math.nan, "jaw_normal_at_lift_N": math.nan, "release_peak_speed_mps": math.nan}
	if len(g) and len(lift):
		d = tel["brick_pos"][lift[0], :2] - tel["brick_pos"][g[0], :2]
		out["grasp_push_mm"] = float(np.linalg.norm(d) * 1000.0)
		out["jaw_normal_at_lift_N"] = float(np.min(tel["pinch_normal"][lift[0]]))
	if len(place):
		g_cmd = tel["q_cmd"][place, 5]
		opening = place[g_cmd > g_cmd.min() + 0.02]
		if len(opening):
			out["release_peak_speed_mps"] = float(np.linalg.norm(tel["brick_vel"][opening[0] :], axis=1).max())
	return out


def run_closed_loop_episode(
	cell: Cell,
	params: ExpertParams | None = None,
	*,
	q_start: np.ndarray,
	bowl_xy: tuple[float, float],
	brick_xy: tuple[float, float],
	brick_yaw_deg: float,
	non_ideal: NonIdealityCfg | None = None,
) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], np.ndarray, dict]:
	"""Run one closed-loop episode on ``cell``; returns (telemetry, phases, info)."""
	params = params or ExpertParams()
	episode = PhysicsEpisode(cell, q_start, brick_xy=brick_xy, brick_yaw_deg=brick_yaw_deg, non_ideal=non_ideal)
	expert = ClosedLoopExpert(cell, q_start, bowl_xy, params)
	phases: list[int] = []
	while episode.n_frames < params.max_frames:
		target, phase = expert.act(_observe(cell, episode))
		if expert.done:
			break
		episode.step(target)
		phases.append(PHASES.index(phase))
	tel = episode.telemetry()
	ph = np.array(phases, dtype=np.uint8)
	info = episode_diagnostics(tel, ph)
	info.update(
		n_frames=int(len(ph)),
		grasp_retries=int(expert.grasp_retries),
		brick_lost=bool(expert.lost),
		grasp_geometry=getattr(expert, "grasp_info", {}),
	)
	return tel, ph, info

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExpertParams:
	"""Every tunable number of :class:`ClosedLoopExpert`. Lengths in metres, angles in radians unless the name says

	rest_s: float = 0.3  # initial hold at rest

	ready_move_s: float = 0.8
	hover_z_m: float = 0.06  # gripper-frame height above the grasp point before descending

	final_descend_s: float = 0.6
	grasp_tcp_z_m: float = 0.008  # gripper-frame height at the grasp

	servo_tol_m: float = 0.0008  # gripper-frame position error accepted before closing
	servo_gain: float = 0.6  # fraction of the measured gripper-frame error fed back into the target per frame

	close_s: float = 0.5  # gripper closing ramp
	clamp_force_n: float = 1.5  # both jaws' normal force needed for a clamp
	clamp_still_speed_mps: float = 0.005  # brick speed below which it counts as stationary
	clamp_still_frames: int = 4  # consecutive clamped, stationary frames before lifting
	clamp_timeout_frames: int = 45  # frames after the closing ramp before a grasp attempt is abandoned

	lift_s: float = 1.2
	show_flex: float = 0.65  # wrist flex of the show poses (rad)
	show_roll_deg: tuple[float, float, float] = (-35.0, 0.0, 35.0)
	show_move_s: float = 0.9
	show_hold_s: float = 0.4
	handoff_move_s: float = 1.5
	handoff_hold_s: float = 0.6
	transfer_z_m: float = 0.12  # gripper-frame height when moving over the bowl
	transfer_s: float = 1.8
	release_clearance_m: float = 0.004  # brick bottom above the bowl floor at release
	place_descend_s: float = 1.2
	open_ramp_s: float = 1.0  # gripper opening ramp at release
	settle_speed_mps: float = 0.01
	settle_frames: int = 6
	settle_timeout_s: float = 1.5
	retreat_dz_m: float = 0.06
	retreat_s: float = 0.8
	return_s: float = 1.2
	final_hold_s: float = 0.9
	lost_force_n: float = 0.02  # a jaw below this normal force has lost contact
	lost_frames: int = 10  # consecutive frames without dual contact after lift: brick lost
	max_frames: int = 900
	bowl_floor_z_m: float = 0.003
	bowl_margin_m: float = 0.012  # keep the brick's corners this far inside the bowl radius
	clutter_clearance_m: float = 0.03  # preferred distance of the release point from clutter bricks


class _Kinematics:
	"""A private ``MjData`` on the cell's model for IK and forward kinematics: the simulation state is never
	touched. Exposes the attributes the solvers in :mod:`.ik` read."""

	def __init__(self, cell: Cell) -> None:
		self.model = cell.model
		self.data = mujoco.MjData(cell.model)
		self.data.qpos[:] = cell.data.qpos
		mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)
		for name in ("site", "qadr", "dofadr", "jnt_range", "jaw_body", "grip_body"):
			setattr(self, name, getattr(cell, name))

	def site_pose(self, q: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
		"""Gripper-frame position and rotation matrix at joint angles ``q``."""
		self.data.qpos[self.qadr] = q
		mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.model, self.data)
		return self.data.site_xpos[self.site].copy(), self.data.site_xmat[self.site].reshape(3, 3).copy()


def _geom_points(model, gid: int) -> np.ndarray:
	"""Vertices (mesh) or bounding-box corners (primitives) of geom ``gid`` in its own frame."""
	t = model.geom_type[gid]
	s = model.geom_size[gid]
	signs = np.array([(x, y, z) for x in (-1.0, 1.0) for y in (-1.0, 1.0) for z in (-1.0, 1.0)])
	if t == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_MESH:
		mid = model.geom_dataid[gid]
		a, n = model.mesh_vertadr[mid], model.mesh_vertnum[mid]
		return model.mesh_vert[a : a + n].astype(np.float64)
	if t == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_BOX:
		return signs * s
	if t == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_SPHERE:
		return signs * s[0]
	if t == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_CAPSULE:
		return signs * np.array([s[0], s[0], s[1] + s[0]])
	return signs * model.geom_rbound[gid]


def jaw_pad_faces(cell: Cell, kin: _Kinematics, q: np.ndarray, band: tuple[float, float]) -> tuple[float, float]:
	"""Inner faces of the fixed and moving jaw along the gripper frame's z axis (fixed → moving jaw), metres.

	Computed from the compiled collision geoms at joint angles ``q``, keeping only geometry whose gripper-frame x
	(the approach axis, pointing down) lies in ``band`` — the slab the brick occupies. Returns the largest z of the
	fixed jaw and the smallest z of the moving jaw (``inf`` when the moving jaw is clear of the slab).
	"""
	pos, rot = kin.site_pose(q)
	m, d = kin.model, kin.data
	faces = []
	for geoms, pick in ((cell.fixed_jaw_geoms, np.max), (cell.moving_jaw_geoms, np.min)):
		pts = []
		for gid in sorted(geoms):
			w = d.geom_xpos[gid] + _geom_points(m, gid) @ d.geom_xmat[gid].reshape(3, 3).T
			pts.append((w - pos) @ rot)
		p = np.vstack(pts)
		p = p[(p[:, 0] >= band[0]) & (p[:, 0] <= band[1])]
		faces.append(float(pick(p[:, 2])) if len(p) else (np.inf if pick is np.min else -np.inf))
	return faces[0], faces[1]


def _quat_xyzw_to_mat(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
	x, y, z, w = q
	return np.array(
		[
			[1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z), 2 * (x * y - z * w), 2 * (x * z + y * w)],
			[2 * (x * y + z * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z), 2 * (y * z - x * w)],
			[2 * (x * z - y * w), 2 * (y * z + x * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y)],
		]
	)


def _min_jerk(n: int) -> np.ndarray:
	s = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n)
	return 10 * s**3 - 15 * s**4 + 6 * s**5


class ClosedLoopExpert:
	"""Per-frame pick → show → handoff → place policy on privileged simulator state.

	``act(obs)`` takes the current observation (``q``, ``tcp``, ``brick_pos``, ``brick_quat``, ``brick_vel``,
	``jaw_normal``) and returns ``(joint_target, phase)``; ``done`` turns True when the episode script has ended.
	"""

	def __init__(self, cell: Cell, q_start: np.ndarray, bowl_xy: tuple[float, float], params: ExpertParams) -> None:
		self.cell = cell
		self.p = params
		self.q_start = np.asarray(q_start, dtype=np.float64).copy()
		self.bowl_xy = np.asarray(bowl_xy, dtype=np.float64)
		self.kin = _Kinematics(cell)
		self.size = tuple(cell.layout.brick_size)
		self.obs: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
		self.last = self.q_start.copy()
		self.grasp_retries = 0
		self.lost = False
		self.done = False
		self._gen = self._script()
		lo, hi = cell.jnt_range[:, 0], cell.jnt_range[:, 1]
		self._lo, self._hi = lo.copy(), hi.copy()

	# -- plumbing --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	def act(self, obs: dict[str, np.ndarray]) -> tuple[np.ndarray, str]:
		self.obs = obs
		try:
			target, phase = next(self._gen)
		except StopIteration:
			self.done = True
			return self.last.copy(), "return"
		target = np.clip(target, self._lo, self._hi)
		self.last = target.copy()
		return target, phase

	def _frames(self, secs: float) -> int:
		return max(1, round(secs * FPS))

	def _move(self, q_to: np.ndarray, secs: float, phase: str):
		q_from = self.last.copy()
		n = max(2, self._frames(secs) + 1)
		for s in _min_jerk(n)[1:]:
			yield q_from + s * (q_to - q_from), phase

	def _hold(self, secs: float, phase: str):
		for _ in range(self._frames(secs)):
			yield self.last.copy(), phase

	def _ik(self, target: np.ndarray, q0: np.ndarray, roll: float) -> np.ndarray:
		from .ik import ik_reach

		q = ik_reach(self.kin, np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float64), q0, roll)
		q[5] = q0[5]
		return q

	def _dual(self) -> bool:
		f = self.obs.get("jaw_normal", np.zeros(2))
		return bool(f[0] > self.p.lost_force_n and f[1] > self.p.lost_force_n)

	# -- grasp geometry --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	def _grasp_plan(self) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float, np.ndarray]:
		"""Gripper-frame target, wrist roll and the grasp joint angles for the brick's current pose."""
		p = self.p
		bpos = self.obs["brick_pos"]
		rot_b = _quat_xyzw_to_mat(self.obs["brick_quat"])
		short = rot_b[:2, 1] / max(np.linalg.norm(rot_b[:2, 1]), 1e-9)
		half_w = 0.5 * self.size[1]
		q_seed = np.array([*p.ready_q, p.open_g])
		q_hover = self._ik(np.array([bpos[0], bpos[1], p.hover_z_m]), q_seed, 0.0)
		# roll that lines the gripper-frame z axis (fixed → moving jaw) up with the short axis, either sign
		lo, hi = self.cell.jnt_range[4]
		best = (-np.inf, 0.0)
		for roll in np.linspace(lo, hi, 721):
			q_hover[4] = roll
			_, rot = self.kin.site_pose(q_hover)
			z = rot[:2, 2]
			score = abs(float(z @ short)) / max(np.linalg.norm(z), 1e-9) - 0.02 * abs(roll)
			if score > best[0]:
				best = (score, float(roll))
		roll = best[1]
		# iterate: the pad faces and the jaw axis depend on the solved pose
		target = np.array([bpos[0], bpos[1], p.grasp_tcp_z_m])
		q = q_hover.copy()
		q[4] = roll
		for _ in range(3):
			q = self._ik(target, q, roll)
			q[5] = p.open_g
			_, rot = self.kin.site_pose(q)
			zdir = rot[:, 2].copy()
			zdir[2] = 0.0
			zdir /= max(np.linalg.norm(zdir), 1e-9)
			band = (p.grasp_tcp_z_m - self.size[2] - 0.0 - bpos[2] + self.size[2] / 2.0, p.grasp_tcp_z_m)
			band = (-(bpos[2] + self.size[2] / 2.0 - p.grasp_tcp_z_m), p.grasp_tcp_z_m - (bpos[2] - self.size[2] / 2.0))
			fixed_face, moving_face = jaw_pad_faces(self.cell, self.kin, q, band)
			# brick centre sits at gripper-frame z = fixed_face + pad clearance + half width
			offset = -(fixed_face + p.pad_clearance_m + half_w)
			target = np.array([bpos[0] + offset * zdir[0], bpos[1] + offset * zdir[1], p.grasp_tcp_z_m])
		self.grasp_info = {"fixed_face_m": fixed_face, "moving_face_m": moving_face, "offset_m": offset}
		return target, roll, q

	# -- the episode script ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	def _servo(self, target: np.ndarray, q: np.ndarray, roll: float, phase: str):
		"""Hold the gripper frame at ``target``, feeding back the measured error, until within tolerance."""
		p = self.p
		corr = np.zeros(3)
		for _ in range(p.servo_max_frames):
			err = target - self.obs["tcp"]
			if np.linalg.norm(err) < p.servo_tol_m:
				break
			corr = np.clip(corr + p.servo_gain * err, -p.servo_max_correction_m, p.servo_max_correction_m)
			q_cmd = self._ik(target + corr, self.last, roll)
			yield q_cmd, phase
		return corr

	def _script(self):
		p = self.p
		yield from self._hold(p.rest_s, "rest")
		q = np.array([*p.ready_q, p.open_g])
		yield from self._move(q, p.ready_move_s, "approach")
		attempts = 0
		clamped = False
		phase = "approach"
		while True:
			target, roll, q_grasp = self._grasp_plan()
			hover = target + np.array([0.0, 0.0, p.hover_z_m - p.grasp_tcp_z_m])
			pre = target + np.array([0.0, 0.0, p.pregrasp_dz_m])
			q = self._ik(hover, self.last if attempts else q_grasp, roll)
			q[5] = p.open_g
			yield from self._move(q, p.hover_move_s, phase)
			q = self._ik(pre, q, roll)
			yield from self._move(q, p.descend_s, phase)
			q = self._ik(target, q, roll)
			yield from self._move(q, p.final_descend_s, "grasp")
			corr = yield from self._servo(target, q, roll, "grasp")
			q_hold = self.last.copy()
			q_closed = q_hold.copy()
			q_closed[5] = p.hold_g
			yield from self._move(q_closed, p.close_s, "grasp")
			still = 0
			for _ in range(p.clamp_timeout_frames):
				f = self.obs["jaw_normal"]
				v = float(np.linalg.norm(self.obs["brick_vel"]))
				still = still + 1 if (min(f) >= p.clamp_force_n and v < p.clamp_still_speed_mps) else 0
				if still >= p.clamp_still_frames:
					clamped = True
					break
				yield self.last.copy(), "grasp"
			if clamped or attempts >= p.max_grasp_retries:
				break
			attempts += 1
			self.grasp_retries = attempts
			phase = "grasp"
			q_open = self.last.copy()
			q_open[5] = p.open_g
			yield from self._move(q_open, p.reopen_s, "grasp")
			q_up = self._ik(self.obs["tcp"] + np.array([0.0, 0.0, p.hover_z_m - p.grasp_tcp_z_m]), self.last, roll)
			q_up[5] = p.open_g
			yield from self._move(q_up, p.descend_s, "grasp")
		self.corr = corr
		# lift
		lift_target = np.array([target[0], target[1], p.lift_z_m]) + corr
		q_lift = self._ik(lift_target, self.last, roll)
		q_lift[5] = p.hold_g
		yield from self._carry(self._move(q_lift, p.lift_s, "lift"))
		if not self.lost:
			for wr in p.show_roll_deg:
				q_show = q_lift.copy()
				q_show[3] = p.show_flex
				q_show[4] = math.radians(wr)
				yield from self._carry(self._move(q_show, p.show_move_s, "show_move"))
				yield from self._carry(self._hold(p.show_hold_s, "show_hold"))
				if self.lost:
					break
		if not self.lost:
			q_hand = np.array([*HANDOFF_Q, p.hold_g])
			yield from self._carry(self._move(q_hand, p.handoff_move_s, "handoff"))
			yield from self._carry(self._hold(p.handoff_hold_s, "handoff"))
		if not self.lost:
			yield from self._place(q_lift, roll)
		q_rest = self.q_start.copy()
		q_rest[5] = max(self.last[5], p.open_g) if not self.lost else p.open_g
		yield from self._move(q_rest, p.return_s, "return")
		yield from self._hold(p.final_hold_s, "return")

	def _carry(self, frames):
		"""Pass carry frames through, watching for a lost brick (no recovery: the episode just ends)."""
		for item in frames:
			if self.lost:
				return
			yield item
			self._no_dual = 0 if self._dual() else getattr(self, "_no_dual", 0) + 1
			if self._no_dual >= self.p.lost_frames:
				self.lost = True

	def _release_xy(self) -> np.ndarray:
		"""Release point: the bowl centre, or the point inside the bowl farthest from any clutter brick."""
		p = self.p
		m, d = self.cell.model, self.cell.data
		clutter = []
		for b in range(m.nbody):
			name = mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, b) or ""
			if name.startswith("clutter_"):
				clutter.append(d.xpos[b, :2].copy())
		if not clutter:
			return self.bowl_xy.copy()
		half_diag = 0.5 * math.hypot(self.size[0], self.size[1])
		r_max = max(BOWL_R - half_diag - p.bowl_margin_m, 0.0)
		best, best_score = self.bowl_xy.copy(), -np.inf
		for r in np.linspace(0.0, r_max, 6):
			for a in np.linspace(0.0, 2 * math.pi, 24, endpoint=False):
				c = self.bowl_xy + r * np.array([math.cos(a), math.sin(a)])
				dmin = min(float(np.linalg.norm(c - x)) for x in clutter)
				score = min(dmin, p.clutter_clearance_m + half_diag) - 0.1 * r
				if score > best_score:
					best, best_score = c, score
		return best

	def _place(self, q_lift: np.ndarray, roll: float):
		p = self.p
		rxy = self._release_xy()
		q = self._ik(np.array([rxy[0], rxy[1], p.transfer_z_m]), q_lift, roll)
		q[5] = p.hold_g
		yield from self._carry(self._move(q, p.transfer_s, "place"))
		if self.lost:
			return
		dz = self.obs["brick_pos"][2] - self.obs["tcp"][2]
		z_tcp = p.bowl_floor_z_m + p.release_clearance_m + self.size[2] / 2.0 - dz
		q = self._ik(np.array([rxy[0], rxy[1], z_tcp]), q, roll)
		q[5] = p.hold_g
		yield from self._carry(self._move(q, p.place_descend_s, "place"))
		if self.lost:
			return
		q_open = self.last.copy()
		q_open[5] = p.open_g
		yield from self._move(q_open, p.open_ramp_s, "place")
		still = 0
		for _ in range(self._frames(p.settle_timeout_s)):
			v = float(np.linalg.norm(self.obs["brick_vel"]))
			still = still + 1 if v < p.settle_speed_mps else 0
			if still >= p.settle_frames:
				break
			yield self.last.copy(), "place"
		q_up = self._ik(self.obs["tcp"] + np.array([0.0, 0.0, p.retreat_dz_m]), self.last, roll)
		q_up[5] = p.open_g
		yield from self._move(q_up, p.retreat_s, "place")


def _observe(cell: Cell, episode: PhysicsEpisode) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
	lv, _ = cell.brick_vel()
	jaw = episode.last("pinch_normal") if episode.n_frames else np.zeros(2)
	return {
		"q": cell.joints(),
		"tcp": cell.tcp_pos(),
		"brick_pos": cell.brick_pos(),
		"brick_quat": cell.brick_quat_xyzw(),
		"brick_vel": lv,
		"jaw_normal": np.asarray(jaw, dtype=np.float64),
	}


def episode_diagnostics(tel: dict[str, np.ndarray], phases: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float]:
	"""``grasp_push_mm``, ``jaw_normal_at_lift_N`` and ``release_peak_speed_mps`` from an episode's telemetry
	(``nan`` when the episode never reached the phase the metric needs)."""
	ph = np.asarray(phases)
	g = np.flatnonzero(ph == PHASES.index("grasp"))
	lift = np.flatnonzero(ph == PHASES.index("lift"))
	place = np.flatnonzero(ph == PHASES.index("place"))
	out = {"grasp_push_mm": math.nan, "jaw_normal_at_lift_N": math.nan, "release_peak_speed_mps": math.nan}
	if len(g) and len(lift):
		d = tel["brick_pos"][lift[0], :2] - tel["brick_pos"][g[0], :2]
		out["grasp_push_mm"] = float(np.linalg.norm(d) * 1000.0)
		out["jaw_normal_at_lift_N"] = float(np.min(tel["pinch_normal"][lift[0]]))
	if len(place):
		g_cmd = tel["q_cmd"][place, 5]
		opening = place[g_cmd > g_cmd.min() + 0.02]
		if len(opening):
			out["release_peak_speed_mps"] = float(np.linalg.norm(tel["brick_vel"][opening[0] :], axis=1).max())
	return out


def run_closed_loop_episode(
	cell: Cell,
	params: ExpertParams | None = None,
	*,
	q_start: np.ndarray,
	bowl_xy: tuple[float, float],
	brick_xy: tuple[float, float],
	brick_yaw_deg: float,
	non_ideal: NonIdealityCfg | None = None,
) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], np.ndarray, dict]:
	"""Run one closed-loop episode on ``cell``; returns (telemetry, phases, info)."""
	params = params or ExpertParams()
	episode = PhysicsEpisode(cell, q_start, brick_xy=brick_xy, brick_yaw_deg=brick_yaw_deg, non_ideal=non_ideal)
	expert = ClosedLoopExpert(cell, q_start, bowl_xy, params)
	phases: list[int] = []
	while episode.n_frames < params.max_frames:
		target, phase = expert.act(_observe(cell, episode))
		if expert.done:
			break
		episode.step(target)
		phases.append(PHASES.index(phase))
	tel = episode.telemetry()
	ph = np.array(phases, dtype=np.uint8)
	info = episode_diagnostics(tel, ph)
	info.update(
		n_frames=int(len(ph)),
		grasp_retries=int(expert.grasp_retries),
		brick_lost=bool(expert.lost),
		grasp_geometry=getattr(expert, "grasp_info", {}),
	)
	return tel, ph, info

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExpertParams:
	"""Every tunable number of :class:`ClosedLoopExpert`. Lengths in metres, angles in radians unless the name says
	degrees, durations in seconds, forces in newtons, speeds in metres per second."""

	open_g: float = 0.85  # gripper command with the jaws open (rad)
	hold_g: float = 0.06  # gripper command while pinching (rad); the gripper torque saturates below contact
	rest_s: float = 0.3  # initial hold at rest
	ready_q: tuple[float, float, float, float, float] = (0.0, -0.35, 0.25, 1.35, 0.0)  # intermediate arm pose (rad)
	ready_move_s: float = 0.8
	hover_z_m: float = 0.06  # gripper-frame height above the grasp point before descending
	hover_move_s: float = 1.4
	pregrasp_dz_m: float = 0.02  # height above the grasp height where the final descent starts
	descend_s: float = 1.0
	final_descend_s: float = 0.6
	grasp_tcp_z_m: float = 0.008  # gripper-frame height at the grasp
	pad_clearance_m: float = 0.002  # gap between the fixed-jaw pad and the brick face before closing
	servo_tol_m: float = 0.0008  # gripper-frame position error accepted before closing
	servo_gain: float = 0.6  # fraction of the measured gripper-frame error fed back into the target per frame
	servo_max_correction_m: float = 0.02  # cap on the accumulated correction
	servo_max_frames: int = 30
	close_s: float = 0.5  # gripper closing ramp
	clamp_force_n: float = 1.5  # both jaws' normal force needed for a clamp
	clamp_still_speed_mps: float = 0.005  # brick speed below which it counts as stationary
	clamp_still_frames: int = 4  # consecutive clamped, stationary frames before lifting
	clamp_timeout_frames: int = 45  # frames after the closing ramp before a grasp attempt is abandoned
	max_grasp_retries: int = 2
	reopen_s: float = 0.5
	lift_z_m: float = 0.12
	lift_s: float = 1.2
	show_flex: float = 0.65  # wrist flex of the show poses (rad)
	show_roll_deg: tuple[float, float, float] = (-35.0, 0.0, 35.0)
	show_move_s: float = 0.9
	show_hold_s: float = 0.4
	handoff_move_s: float = 1.5
	handoff_hold_s: float = 0.6
	transfer_z_m: float = 0.12  # gripper-frame height when moving over the bowl
	transfer_s: float = 1.8
	release_clearance_m: float = 0.004  # brick bottom above the bowl floor at release
	place_descend_s: float = 1.2
	open_ramp_s: float = 1.0  # gripper opening ramp at release
	settle_speed_mps: float = 0.01
	settle_frames: int = 6
	settle_timeout_s: float = 1.5
	retreat_dz_m: float = 0.06
	retreat_s: float = 0.8
	return_s: float = 1.2

	bowl_floor_z_m: float = 0.003
	bowl_margin_m: float = 0.012  # keep the brick's corners this far inside the bowl radius
